, a sharp turnaround from the days when he openly dismissed the asset class.
When Trump Was Skeptical of Crypto
During his first term as president in July 2019, Trump said he was no “fan” of Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, whose value, he added, was based on “thin air.”
“Unregulated Crypto Assets can facilitate unlawful behavior, including drug trade and other illegal activity….,” he added.
Trump also asserted that the dollar is America’s only “real currency,” describing it as both “dependable and reliable.”

I am not a fan of Bitcoin and other Cryptocurrencies, which are not money, and whose value is highly volatile and based on thin air. Unregulated Crypto Assets can facilitate unlawful behavior, including drug trade and other illegal activity….
Bitcoin’s Surge Since Trump’s Remarks
When Trump made these statements, one Bitcoin was worth $11,815.99.
Fast forward to August 2026; the asset’s price has zoomed to $77,525. That’s an increase of 556%. So, a $1,000 investment would have grown into $6,561 today
